verdict.rationale: Bulk triage is a fair axis for an email client like Outlook, but the pack never documents selecting many conversations and archiving, labeling, or marking them done in one action. The Graph API items cover per-message update, flagging, categories, and Inbox rules. These are developer building blocks or adjacent automation, not a user-facing bulk-action capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can select many conversations at once and archive, label, or mark them done in one stroke
